notes:
⚠️ JAVASCRIPT-RENDERED SITE - Requires Playwright/Selenium/Puppeteer

This site uses an IDX (Internet Data Exchange) system that loads all listing data dynamically via JavaScript. The initial HTML contains only a loading screen and empty containers.

TECHNICAL DETAILS:
- Platform: IDX Broker (commercial real estate IDX)
- Content loads via AJAX after page load
- Listings container: .IDX-results-item (not present in static HTML)
- Alternative URLs tried: /listings (same issue)

SCRAPING APPROACH NEEDED:
1. Use headless browser (Playwright/Puppeteer/Selenium)
2. Wait for selector: .IDX-results-item or #IDX-resultsContainer
3. Wait for AJAX loading to complete (check for #IDX-loadingScreen to hide)
4. Then extract listing data using the selectors above

ALTERNATIVE APPROACH:
- Monitor network requests for API calls (likely /idx/ajax/*.php endpoints)
- May be able to call API directly for JSON data
- Requires reverse-engineering their AJAX calls

SELECTORS (for use with JS rendering):
- Container: .IDX-results-item
- Title/Address: .IDX-results-address
- Price: .IDX-results-price
- Location: .IDX-results-cityState
- Description: .IDX-results-remarks
- Link: a.IDX-results-detailsLink
- Property Type: .IDX-results-propertyType
- Square Footage: .IDX-results-sqft
